findings.title: NetworkPolicy selects no pods
findings.cause: NetworkPolicy web-ingress selects pods with app=webapp, and no pod or workload in namespace kd-networkpolicy-selects-nothing has those labels, so it restricts nothing (the closest pod labels are app=web)

evidence.command: kubectl get networkpolicy web-ingress -n kd-networkpolicy-selects-nothing -o jsonpath='{.spec.podSelector}'

findings.fix: Change the policy's podSelector to match the pods it should restrict (app=web).
